text: dsh-plugin-desktop-restart 是一个面向 Windows 桌面版 DeepSeek Harness 的界面插件。它通过 bundle 注入客户端代码，在窗口标题栏的应用和编辑菜单旁添加重启按钮。用户首次点击进入确认状态，再次点击才调用桌面桥接请求重启；点击其他位置会撤销确认。按钮会随界面语言更新，并在请求失败时显示提示。插件需要先对桌面应用的 app.asar 应用仓库附带的补丁，普通浏览器页面不显示该按钮。

dsh-plugin-desktop-restart adds a restart button beside the Application and Edit menus in the Windows DSH app. The first click asks for confirmation; the second requests a restart. The app.asar patch is required, and the button is absent in a regular browser page.
想给 Windows 桌面版 DSH 加一个手动重启入口。
能不能在应用菜单边上放个重启按钮，而且避免误触？
How can I restart the desktop app from its title bar with a confirmation step?
dsh-plugin-desktop-restart 的功能「二次确认重启」：在 Windows 标题栏菜单行添加重启按钮。第一次点击显示确认状态，再点击后通过桌面桥接发起应用重启；点击别处会取消确认。
dsh-plugin-desktop-restart 的功能「按界面语言显示」：注册中英文按钮和状态文案，并订阅语言变化来刷新按钮标签；重启请求失败时显示失败状态。

dsh-plugin-desktop-restart README · 中文简介：在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面窗口的标题栏（「应用 / 编辑」同一行）右侧加一个**重启按钮**：第一次点击变为「确认重启」，再点一次才真正重启应用，避免误触中断正在运行的任务。

- 重启由 Electron 外壳执行，插件通过打过补丁的 `window.dshDesktop.restart()` 调用；
- 应用更新会替换 `app.asar`，补丁与按钮随之消失；用 `tools/patch-shell-restart.mjs` 重新打补丁即可恢复；
- 按钮只在桌面应用窗口渲染（普通浏览器页面没有该桥接，不会显示）；
- 补丁原理与字节长度保持细节见下方英文小节。

A **Restart** button in the sidebar footer of the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, next
to the account credit chip.

dsh-plugin-desktop-restart README · Why the app has to be patched for this：The restart is the Electron shell's job — only it can relaunch the process — and
the shell exposes exactly one channel to the page: the preload bridge
(`window.dshDesktop`). That bridge ships with no restart method, and the shell's
own "Restart App and Host" item is built behind a `development` flag, so a plugin
cannot reach it. This plugin therefore needs two size-preserving edits inside the
application's `resources/app.asar`, applied by `tools/patch-shell-restart.mjs`:
section: Why the app has to be patched for this

text:
dsh-plugin-desktop-restart README · Why the app has to be patched for this：| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `/lib/main.js` | A `dsh-desktop:restart` IPC handler that validates the sender and calls `app.relaunch(); quitWithoutConfirmation()` — the shell's own relaunch idiom. |
| `/lib/preload-app.cjs` | `restart()` on the `dshDesktop` bridge, so the page can invoke that handler. |
section: Why the app has to be patched for this

text:
dsh-plugin-desktop-restart README · Why the app has to be patched for this：Both edits keep their file's byte length identical (each inserts code and rewrites
one comment block to absorb exactly the same number of bytes), so no offset in the
ASAR moves and every other file stays untouched.

**An app update replaces `app.asar` and removes the patch**; the button then
disappears by itself, because it only renders when the bridge actually provides
`restart` (see below). Re-apply with the same tool to get it back.
section: Why the app has to be patched for this

text:
dsh-plugin-desktop-restart README · What the button does：It sits in the **Windows caption menubar**, the row at the top of the application
window that already holds **应用 / 编辑** (Application / Edit).

dsh-plugin-desktop-restart README · What the button does：That row is built by the desktop preload, not by the Web client: it is a
`div[data-windows-menu]` with an **open** shadow root containing a `<style>` and
`div[role=menubar]`, plus one button per menu. Open mode is what makes this
placement possible without patching the shell again — the plugin reaches the
menubar through `host.shadowRoot` and appends its own `<button>`, which the shadow
tree's element styles then dress exactly like the shipped buttons. The plugin
therefore ships no CSS at all.

dsh-plugin-desktop-restart README · What the button does：- It renders **only when `window.dshDesktop.restart` is a function** and the
  caption row exists. Opened as a plain page over the loopback URL there is no
  bridge and no caption row, so nothing is added rather than a button that cannot
  work. The preload mounts that row once the shell overlay appears, so the plugin
  watches for it (a `MutationObserver` plus a slow poll, both torn down with the
  plugin).
- The confirmation lives in the button's own label: the first click turns 重启 into
  确认重启 (tinted with the warning colour), and only the second click asks the
  shell to relaunch. The shell's relaunch path does not ask about in-flight work,
  so without that step a stray click would discard a running task. Clicking
  anywhere else withdraws the confirmation.
- While the request is in flight the label reads 正在重启…; a refused request is
  reported in the label and logged to the console.
- The label follows the interface language through the client locale service, and
  the button stays out of the menubar's roving tab order (`tabIndex = -1`).

dsh-plugin-desktop-restart README · Layout：| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `lib/client.js` | The whole feature: the caption-row mount, the button, its confirmation, and the zh/en dictionaries. |
| `lib/index.js` | Host half — an empty `apply`; the row just has to exist for the browser half to be served. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch inserting the `desktop-restart` row **by bare package name** (a subpath would leave the browser half unresolved). |

dsh-plugin-desktop-restart README · Install and verify：Register the package as a profile bundle (`cordis.patch.yml`), then restart
DSH so the client row is composed. The shell patch is applied with the tool
bundled in this repository:

```bash
dsh-plugin-desktop-restart README · rehearse on a workspace copy (the real archive is not touched)：node tools/patch-shell-restart.mjs "D:/DeepseekHarness/resources/app.asar"
section: rehearse on a workspace copy (the real archive is not touched)

text:
dsh-plugin-desktop-restart README · back up, install, re-verify; restores the backup automatically on any doubt：node tools/patch-shell-restart.mjs "D:/DeepseekHarness/resources/app.asar" --apply
```
